categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong Weide Information Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the electric power distribution network information security sector. Its main business segments include the research, development, production, and sales of intelligent security devices and information security cloud platforms, along with providing related information technology services such as software development, system integration, and operation maintenance services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on core technologies such as industrial security communication based on national cryptographic algorithms, heterogeneous communication integration, low-power dynamic power adjustment, secure operating system hardening, multi-processor coordination for small security terminals, extensive industrial protocol filtering, and software-defined hybrid cloud security. It employs a production model centered on in-house software development and hardware design, with some outsourced PCB assembly and component insertion, following a make-to-order approach with appropriate inventory stocking.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major electric grid companies such as State Grid Corporation of China and China Southern Power Grid, as well as well-known power equipment providers like Beijing Kerei, Changyuan Shenrui, and Zhuhai XJ Electric. The company mainly serves the electric power distribution network information security market but is also expanding into other industrial sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with sales and marketing activities covering regions including East China, South China, Southwest China, North China, Central China, and Northwest China. It has established marketing branches in cities such as Chengdu, Xi'an, and Beijing.
categories.supply_chain_position: Guangdong Weide Information Technology operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the development and production of intelligent security hardware and software products for electric power distribution networks. It procures raw materials and outsources certain manufacturing processes like PCB assembly but retains core technology development and final product assembly in-house.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation with a focus on electric power distribution network information security. It invests significantly in R&D, emphasizing breakthroughs in electric power metering encryption, domestic core component localization, AI model integration, and industrial data security management. Ongoing projects include next-generation intelligent security products, information security cloud platform enhancements, and digital transformation initiatives aligned with national energy and industrial policies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of intelligent security devices and information security cloud platform products, supplemented by income from information technology services such as software development, system integration, and maintenance. The company mainly uses direct sales to end customers (electric grid companies and equipment providers) and also employs a dealer sales model.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the electric power distribution network information security niche, leveraging early market entry and strong technological capabilities. It faces competition from larger, more established cybersecurity firms like Venustech and Westone, which have broader scale and R&D resources. Guangdong Weide differentiates itself through specialized industry knowledge, domestic core technology development, and close customer relationships with major power grid operators.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 98.44 million, a decrease of 18.03% year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 11.57 million, down 35.73%. The company maintains total assets around RMB 870 million and equity of RMB 820 million. Despite recent revenue and profit declines, it continues to invest about 9.69% of revenue in R&D, indicating a focus on long-term growth and innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Guangdong Weide emphasizes autonomous controllability, high security, and reliability of its intelligent security devices and cloud platforms, integrating national cryptographic standards and advanced industrial communication technologies. Its products are tailored for complex industrial environments, offering hardware-level dynamic encryption, compatibility with domestic AI models, and comprehensive security solutions. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, patent portfolio, and close alignment with national energy and cybersecurity policies provide competitive differentiation.
